data.title: SME Bank Wins 2026 SME Financier of the Year Award for Middle East, North Africa
data.content:
Singapore, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Small and Medium Enterprises Bank (SME Bank) won the 2026 SME Financier of the Year Award for the Middle East and North Africa region at the Global SME Finance Awards ceremony held in Singapore on November 19.
    The award recognizes the bank's efforts to finance small and medium enterprises and support their growth through an integrated ecosystem that includes indirect lending, loan guarantees, and venture capital investment.
    Cumulative data for the ecosystem from 2006 through the end of the second quarter of 2026 reflect the scale of these efforts. Total financing provided through indirect lending and loan guarantee programs exceeded SAR145 billion, while the value of guarantees issued surpassed SAR99 billion. Meanwhile, the Saudi Venture Capital Company's total investment commitments exceeded SAR4.6 billion.
    The bank's programs have served more than 30,000 enterprises in cooperation with over 115 partners from government entities and the financial sector, including 50 financing partners. The group's outstanding portfolio reached SAR30 billion, covering indirect lending, loan guarantees, and venture capital investment.
    
    -- SPA
